detail.objective: Attribution accuracy across the whole credit-required set, independent of jurisdiction. Pigment records the Commons wikilink display text as author, so one account appears under two names across four files (E-006) and two CC BY 2.0 files credit the depicted work's painter rather than the photographer their own page names (E-010). Root cause is a single regex at tools/commons_rights.py:118 discarding the anchor href. Carries a scope dependency: tools/ is outside OP-RIGHTS' may-write table.
